title: A cache with ETags
description:
Avoid downloading things that have not changed.

```
GET /profile -> 200, etag "v1" (downloaded 120 bytes)
GET /profile -> 304 Not Modified (0 bytes, from cache)
server changes the profile
GET /profile -> 200, etag "v2" (downloaded 125 bytes)
```
hints: Look up the cache first and add the header only when there is an ETag (lesson 3.05).
Count downloaded bytes in the client to show the saving.
requirements: Send `If-None-Match` with the stored ETag; on 304 return the cached body.
A fake server (in the starter) answers 200 or 304.
stretch: Also honour `Cache-Control: max-age=60` and skip the request entirely while the copy is fresh.
